subquestions.text_open: 1-2-2 Anhydrous AuCl_3 reacts with a small amount of CO to produce “AuCl_2,” which exists as a tetramer. The molecule possesses only a C_2 axis and a mirror plane perpendicular to the C_2 axis. Write the chemical equation for the reaction and the SMILES structure of tetrameric AuCl_2.

1-3 Au can form cluster compounds with unusual frameworks. Based on the descriptions, write reasonable SMILES structures for the following complexes. 1-3-1 Complex Au_4(dppm)_3I_2: the numbers of Au atoms in two chemical environments are in a ratio of 1:3; every Au is coordinated by one I atom; and all dppm ligands have the same chemical environment. (dppm=Ph_2PCH_2PPh_2)
